description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-071 Human Recources Management against its three linked human resources records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's three governed headings, cited with the verified display corrections. Only explicitly written terms are mapped (recruitment, selection, hiring, induction, discipline management, employee welfare, labour law). The abbreviations 'JD, JA', 'PE System', 'T and D' and 'LR System' are not expanded: the corresponding NYSC cells are INSUFFICIENT_DATA, so they never generate Areas to Investigate.

hr_training_development: coordinating employee training or learning and development
hr_performance: managing or supporting employee performance processes
hr_payroll_records: maintaining HR records or information systems

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (units, modules, learning outcomes or verified scope passages as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: Two Sri Lankan standards are linked: the NVQ Level 4 Human Resources Associate standard and the exact-title NVQ Level 5/6 Human Resource Management diploma standard, because the NYSC course level is not stated.
Australian cells assess the 6 core units only; electives are not stored.
